question: Some seeds are dispersed when the fruits burst with sudden jerks and the seeds are scattered far from the parent plant. This happens in fruits of which of the following plants?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Castor and Balsam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Castor and Balsam** plants have fruits that burst open with sudden jerks, aiding in the dispersal of seeds over a wide area.
 
• This method of seed dispersal is known as **explosive or ballistic dispersal**.
 
• In **Castor** (Ricinus communis), the fruits dry out and split open forcefully to scatter seeds.
 
• In **Balsam** (Impatiens), the fruits burst open upon slight touch, dispersing seeds in different directions.
 
• This mechanism helps in reducing competition among seedlings and allows colonization of new areas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Seed Dispersal**

 
 
• Seed dispersal is the movement or transport of seeds away from the parent plant.
 
• It can occur through various mechanisms such as wind, water, animals, and explosive mechanisms.
 
• Effective seed dispersal is crucial for the survival and spread of plant species.
 
 
 
• **Explosive Mechanism**
 
 
• Plants like Castor and Balsam exhibit an explosive mechanism where the fruit dehisces (splits open) suddenly to release seeds.
 
• This mechanism involves the buildup of tension in the fruit's tissues, which is released suddenly to scatter seeds.
 
 
 
• **Other Plants with Explosive Dispersal**
 
 
• Other plants that use explosive seed dispersal include Touch-Me-Not (Mimosa pudica) and Pea family members like Lupins.
 
 
 
• **Advantages of Explosive Dispersal**
 
 
• Reduces competition for resources among seedlings.
 
• Helps in the colonization of new areas.
 
• Ensures genetic diversity by spreading seeds over a wider area.
